1031.description: A standing machine move that drives one leg back to work the glutes.
instructions: Stand facing the machine and rest your hands on the support.
Place the back of your working leg against the lever pad.
Push the leg back and slightly up by squeezing the glute.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your torso upright without arching your back. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

1095.description: A triceps dip with your feet on the floor for help. It trains the triceps.
instructions: Hold the handles with arms straight and feet on the floor.
Keep your torso upright.
Bend your elbows to lower.
Use your legs for light help.
Press back up.
Keep your elbows close.

1159.description: A side lunge with the straps for balance, working the outer hips and legs.
instructions: Hold the handles and stand tall.
Step out wide to one side.
Bend that knee and push the hips back.
Keep your chest up and the other leg straight.
Push off to return.
Alternate sides.

1223.description: A bodyweight row under a low bar with an underhand grip. It builds the back and biceps.
instructions: Set a bar at waist height and lie under it, gripping it with palms facing you.
Straighten your body from heels to head.
Pull your chest up to the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower yourself under control until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up the whole time.

1287.description: Press a single dumbbell up from a decline bench. It focuses on the lower chest and lets you train each side separately.
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with a dumbbell in one hand, resting on your chest.
Place your feet flat on the ground and keep your back pressed against the bench.
Extend your arm and push the dumbbell up towards the ceiling, fully extending your elbow.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
instructionsZh: 躺在下斜长凳上，一只手握住哑铃，放在胸前。
将双脚平放在地面上，并将背部压在长凳上。
伸展手臂，将哑铃推向天花板，充分伸展肘部。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

1351.description: A t-bar style machine row with a reverse grip and chest support. It works the upper back, lats and biceps.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Pull the handles towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly release and extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度，将自己放在机器上，胸部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
保持背部挺直并启动核心肌群。
将手柄拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢松开并伸展手臂回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1415.description: Sit with your forearm supported and curl a dumbbell with your wrist in a neutral position. It strengthens the forearms and builds grip.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing up.
Rest your forearm on your thigh, allowing your wrist to hang off the edge.
Keeping your forearm stationary, curl your wrist upward as far as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your wrist back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other hand.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，一手握住哑铃，掌心朝上。
将前臂放在大腿上，让手腕悬在边缘。
保持前臂静止，尽可能向上弯曲手腕。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手腕放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换另一只手。

1479.description: A lever machine chest press with an inclined path, version 2. It builds the upper chest, front delts and triceps.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and backrest angle on the leverage machine to a comfortable position.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and position your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Push the handles forward and away from your body until your arms are fully extended, but without locking your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the fully extended position, then slowly bend your elbows and lower the handles back towards your chest.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将杠杆机上的座椅高度和靠背角度调整到舒适的位置。
坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住手柄，双手之间的距离略大于肩宽。
向前推动手柄并远离身体，直到手臂完全伸展，但不要锁定肘部。
在完全伸展的位置暂停片刻，然后慢慢弯曲肘部并将手柄放回胸部。
重复所需的重复次数。

1543.description: The classic stiff-legged deadlift, hinging at the hips with nearly straight knees. A great builder for hamstrings, glutes and the lower back.
instructions: Stand holding a barbell in front of your thighs, feet hip-width apart.
Keep a slight bend in your knees and push your hips back.
Lower the bar along your legs until you feel a deep stretch in your hamstrings.
Keep your back flat and your chest proud the whole way.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing.

1607.description: A standing cable curl with an SZ bar. The cable keeps constant tension on the biceps.
instructions: Attach an SZ bar to a low pulley and grip it with an underhand grip.
Stand tall with your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly and avoid swinging your body.

1671.description: A standing one-arm hammer curl. It trains the brachialis and biceps with a neutral grip.
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your torso.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your upper arms stationary.
Exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝向躯干。
保持肘部靠近躯干，上臂保持静止。
呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举重，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1735.description: A single-arm dumbbell triceps extension lying down. It isolates one triceps at a time.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in one hand and your arm fully extended above your chest.
Lower the dumbbell in a controlled manner towards your forehead, keeping your upper arm stationary.
Pause briefly at the bottom of the movement, then extend your arm back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，手臂完全伸展到胸部上方。
以受控的方式将哑铃降低到前额，保持上臂静止。
在动作底部短暂暂停，然后将手臂伸展回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1799.description: Hanging from wall bars with both hands lets gravity stretch your lats and decompress your back. Great after heavy pulling days.
instructions: Grip a wall bar overhead with both hands and walk your feet out slightly.
Let your body hang and sink your hips back, relaxing your upper back and shoulders.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1863.description: Machine pulldown behind the line of the body that trains the lats and upper back.
instructions: Adjust the seat and grip the handles overhead.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handles down, driving your elbows toward your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the bottom.
Return slowly to full stretch.

1927.description: A seated ankle stretch that lengthens the front of the lower leg and the inner side of the ankle.
instructions: Sit with one leg extended and hold the foot with your hand.
Point the foot down and turn the sole slightly inward.
Gently press the foot until you feel a stretch along the front and inner ankle.
Move slowly and stop at a mild stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1991.description: A stretch that eases the shoulder into inward rotation.
instructions: Stand tall and place one hand behind your lower back with the elbow bent.
Use the other hand or a towel to gently draw the hand up your back until the back of the shoulder stretches.
Keep your shoulders level and do not twist.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2119.description: Reaches an arm overhead and leans to the side to lengthen the flank, lats and obliques.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Raise one arm overhead with the palm facing inward.
Lean your torso sideways away from the raised arm.
Keep both hips level and your chest facing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return upright and repeat on the other side.

2311.description: Stepping on a stepmill at a steady pace. A tough, low-impact cardio workout for legs and glutes.
instructions: Adjust the stepmill machine to a comfortable level.
Step onto the machine and place your hands on the handrails for support.
Start walking by placing one foot on a step and then the other, alternating between legs.
Maintain an upright posture and engage your core muscles.
Continue walking for the desired duration or distance.
Gradually increase the intensity or speed as you become more comfortable with the exercise.
Remember to cool down and stretch after completing the exercise.
instructionsZh: 将步进机调整到舒适的水平。
走上机器，将双手放在扶手上以获得支撑。
开始行走时，将一只脚放在台阶上，然后将另一只脚放在台阶上，双腿交替。
保持直立姿势并锻炼核心肌肉。
继续步行所需的时间或距离。
当您对锻炼感到更加舒适时，逐渐增加强度或速度。
完成练习后记得冷静下来并伸展身体。

2375.description: A one-leg squat using a support for balance, building strength in each leg.
instructions: Stand next to a sturdy support and hold it lightly with one hand.
Lift one foot slightly off the floor in front of you.
Sit your hips back and lower on the standing leg.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
Push through your heel to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

2567.description: A seated stretch for the piriformis and glute muscles. Helps loosen tight hips.
instructions: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Bend your right knee and place your right foot on the outside of your left knee.
Place your left elbow on the outside of your right knee and gently twist your torso to the right.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides and repeat.
instructionsZh: 坐在地上，双腿在身前伸展。
弯曲右膝，将右脚放在左膝外侧。
将左肘放在右膝外侧，轻轻地将躯干向右扭转。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒，然后换边重复。

2887.description: A hanging leg raise with cable resistance at your feet. Strengthens the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with the cable attached to your ankles.
Keep your arms straight and your body steady.
Raise your legs up in front of you toward hip height or higher.
Curl your pelvis slightly at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.

2951.description: A leg press on a horizontal lever machine. It builds the quads and glutes with back support.
instructions: Sit on the machine with your back flat against the pad and feet on the platform.
Set your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Press the platform away until your legs are nearly straight.
Do not lock your knees.
Lower slowly until your knees are bent about 90 degrees and repeat.

3271.description: Alternate running in place with a shallow knee bend to keep the heart rate up while the legs work.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Jog on the spot for a few steps.
Pause into a shallow knee bend, hips back and chest up.
Stand tall and go straight back into running.
Repeat for 30-60 seconds.

3335.description: A loaded hip bridge that targets your glutes. Resting a dumbbell on your hips adds resistance.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell across your hips.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glutes hard at the top.
Lower your hips slowly and repeat.

3399.description: A lunge with the barbell in the front rack, emphasizing quads and an upright torso.
instructions: Rest the barbell on your front shoulders with elbows high.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your chest tall and your core braced.
Push through the front foot to return.
Alternate legs or finish all reps on one side.

3463.description: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 3 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

3527.description: A downward dog with alternating hand-to-toe taps. It stretches the hamstrings and calves.
instructions: Start in a downward facing dog, hips high.
Press your chest toward your thighs.
Reach one hand back to touch the opposite foot.
Return the hand and switch sides.
Keep your hips high.
Move slowly with steady breathing.

3591.description: A standing rotation against band resistance for the obliques and core.
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and hold the handle with both hands.
Stand sideways with arms extended.
Rotate your torso away from the anchor.
Return under control.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

3655.description: A walking lunge with a high knee between each step. It raises your heart rate and trains the legs.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Lift your right knee up towards your chest as high as you can while balancing on your left leg.
Step forward with your right foot and lower your body into a lunge position, bending both knees to a 90-degree angle.
Push off with your right foot and bring your left knee up towards your chest.
Step forward with your left foot and lower your body into a lunge position.
Continue alternating legs and lunging forward, keeping your core engaged and maintaining a steady pace.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与臀部同宽站立。
将右膝尽可能高地抬向胸部，同时用左腿保持平衡。
右脚向前迈出一步，身体降低成弓步姿势，双膝弯曲成 90 度角。
用右脚推出，并将左膝抬向胸部。
左脚向前迈出一步，将身体降低至弓步位置。
继续交替双腿并向前冲刺，保持核心参与并保持稳定的步伐。
重复所需的重复次数。

3719.description: A one-arm cable pushdown from a high pulley, crossing the body to isolate the triceps.
instructions: Set a cable to a high position and hold the handle with one hand.
Stand facing the machine with your elbow bent and tucked.
Press the handle down and across your body until your arm is straight.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

3783.description: A wide-stance move where one arm extends sideways like drawing a bow. It trains your shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Stand with feet wide and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Shift your weight toward the empty-hand side and bend that knee.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side, keeping the other leg straight.
Lower with control and shift back to the center.
Repeat all reps, then switch arms.

3847.description: A diagonal twisting movement against band tension. It trains your obliques and rotational strength.
instructions: Anchor the band at a low point and stand side-on to it.
Hold the handle with both hands.
Rotate your torso and pull the band diagonally upward across your body.
Return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

3911.description: A dumbbell fly with a low path that emphasizes the lower chest.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench or stand and hold dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Move the dumbbells in a wide arc.
Bring them together in front of your lower chest.
Squeeze your chest.
Lower slowly under control.

4039.description: A supported one arm landmine row with your free hand and knee on a bench. It keeps the lower back relaxed while you pull.
instructions: Set the landmine bar next to a bench and place one hand and knee on the bench.
Grip the bar end with your free hand and keep your back flat.
Pull your elbow up toward your hip.
Pause and squeeze your shoulder blade.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch sides.

4103.description: A shrug done holding a trap bar at your sides, loading the traps with a neutral grip.
instructions: Stand inside the trap bar and lift it, holding the handles at your sides.
Keep your arms straight and chest tall.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and do not roll your shoulders.

4167.description: A kettlebell swing with a band adding tension at the hips. It builds hip drive and posterior chain power.
instructions: Set up with the band around your hips and the kettlebell in front of you.
Hinge back and swing the bell between your legs.
Drive your hips forward powerfully.
Let the kettlebell rise to chest height.
Guide it back between your legs as you hinge.
Keep your back flat and arms relaxed.

4231.description: Seated forearm rotation holding a weight to turn your palm upward. It builds forearm strength and wrist control.
instructions: Sit with your forearm resting on your thigh, hand over the knee.
Hold a weighted handle or dumbbell end in your hand.
Start with your palm facing down.
Rotate your forearm slowly until your palm faces up.
Return slowly to the start.
Switch arms after your reps.

4295.description: Lunging forward step after step with a dumbbell in each hand. It builds leg and glute strength and balance.
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step forward with one leg and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee over your ankle.
Push through the front foot and bring the back leg forward into the next step.
Alternate legs for the desired number of steps.

4359.description: A triceps extension with a band held overhead. It trains the long head of the triceps.
instructions: Stand holding a band behind your head, one hand low and one hand high.
Keep your elbows close to your head.
Extend your top arm straight overhead.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly, then switch sides.

4423.description: A bodyweight row hanging under a barbell set in a rack, using a close underhand grip to target the lats and biceps.
instructions: Set a barbell in a rack at about waist height.
Lie underneath and grab it with a close underhand grip.
Keep your body straight and heels on the floor.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower yourself under control.

4487.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the top inner shoulder blade (levator scapulae). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your top inner shoulder blade (levator scapulae) while leaning back against a wall.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4615.description: Standing hip circles that loosen the hip joints and warm up the pelvis.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands on your hips.
Slightly bend your knees.
Move your hips in a large smooth circle, as if drawing it with your belt buckle.
Do several circles one way, then switch direction.
Keep your shoulders still and relaxed.

4679.description: A split squat with band resistance. It works the quads and glutes one leg at a time.
instructions: Stand on the band with your front foot and hold the other end at your shoulders.
Step your other foot back into a split stance.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee stable.
Drive up through the front foot, then switch legs after your set.

4743.description: A biceps curl sitting back on an incline bench. The stretch position works the biceps hard.
instructions: Sit back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight.
Keep your elbows back and your shoulders against the bench.
Curl both dumbbells toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully extended and repeat.

4807.description: A push-up where the hands move from a wide to a narrow position between reps. It shifts the load from chest to triceps.
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest to the floor with your body in a straight line.
Push back up to the top.
Walk your hands in to a narrow, close position.
Repeat a push-up, then step your hands back out wide.

4871.description: A series of six dumbbell raises in different directions. It thoroughly trains the shoulders.
instructions: Hold light dumbbells at your sides.
Raise them to the side and lower.
Raise them to the front and lower.
Then bend forward and raise them out to the rear.
Complete all six variations as one rep.

4935.description: A superman hold where the arms sweep in a circle. It works the lower back, glutes and shoulders.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead.
Lift your chest, arms and legs off the floor.
Sweep your arms out to the sides toward your hips.
Return them overhead in a wide arc.
Keep your legs lifted.
Lower to the floor to rest.

5063.description: Gently glide your chin straight back while seated to wake up the deep neck flexors and ease a forward head posture.
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with your shoulders relaxed and eyes forward.
Keep your chin level, not tilted up or down.
Slide your head straight back as if making a double chin.
Hold for 2-3 seconds without tensing your jaw.
Return slowly to the start and repeat for 10-12 reps.

5383.description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the side of the lower back. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Lie on your side with the roller under your lower back.
Place the roller under the side of the lower back and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll slowly up and down in a small range.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

5447.description: A plate-loaded seated row with an overhand grip. Targets the upper back and lats.
instructions: Sit at the machine with your chest on the pad.
Grab the handles with palms facing down.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly until your arms extend.
Keep your torso steady.

5703.description: A cable curl done leaning back on an incline bench. The arms hang behind the body, which stretches the biceps at the start.
instructions: Set a low cable and lie back on an incline bench facing away from the stack.
Hold the handles with your arms hanging behind you.
Curl the handles up toward your shoulders.
Keep your elbows back and still.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

5895.description: A seated practice of following your breath. Lowers tension and trains focus.
instructions: Sit tall in a comfortable position and relax your shoulders.
Rest your hands on your lap.
Breathe in slowly through your nose.
Breathe out slowly and notice the pause.
Continue for 3-10 minutes.

6151.description: A push-up variation performed with the hands on dumbbells in a reverse hand position. It focuses on the triceps.
instructions: Place two dumbbells on the floor and grip them.
Set up in a plank position.
Lower your chest with your elbows close to your body.
Stop just above the floor.
Press back up to the start.
Keep your body in a straight line.

6215.description: A rollout using dumbbells in place of a wheel. It challenges the abs.
instructions: Kneel holding a dumbbell in each hand on the floor.
Brace your core.
Roll the dumbbells forward.
Go as far as you can keep your back flat.
Pull back to the start.
Avoid sagging at the hips.

6599.description: A low bear crawl with your hips kept down, which challenges your shoulders, legs and core.
instructions: Start on hands and feet with your knees slightly off the floor.
Keep your hips low and your back flat.
Crawl forward with opposite hand and foot.
Stay controlled and quiet.
Crawl for 20-30 seconds.

6791.description: A simple check of how far your shoulder turns inward, handy for spotting tightness before you train.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Reach one arm behind your back with the palm facing out.
Slide your hand slowly up your spine as far as is comfortable.
Note how high your thumb reaches, keeping your chest open.
Lower the arm, then repeat with the other side to compare.

7175.description: Gliding on inline skates for steady cardio that also works the legs and balance.
instructions: Put on skates, helmet and pads, and stand with your knees slightly bent.
Push one skate out to the side and glide on the other.
Alternate pushes with a relaxed arm swing.
Keep your chest up and your weight over the skates.
Skate at a steady pace for 10-30 minutes.
Slow down gradually to stop.

7559.description: Wall sit holding a dumbbell at the chest for extra load.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and lean on a wall.
Slide down until thighs are parallel.
Keep your knees above your ankles.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Stand up slowly.

7623.description: Stretch one side of your back by reaching an arm overhead against a wall. It lengthens the lat and side of the torso.
instructions: Stand beside a wall and place one hand on it above head height.
Step your feet back slightly.
Press your hips away and lean your chest down toward the floor.
Feel the stretch along your side and under the armpit.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

7751.description: A combo that swings the kettlebell into a clean grip and finishes with a front squat for legs and hips.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge back and swing the bell between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to swing, catching it in a clean position at your chest.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Stand back up and lower the bell to swing again.
Keep your back flat throughout.

7879.description: A chest-supported kickback on an incline bench that isolates the triceps.
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Pin your upper arms to your sides.
Straighten your elbows to kick the weights back.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly.
Keep your upper arms still.

8199.description: A seated woodchop with the hands clasped. It works the obliques with no equipment.
instructions: Sit tall on a chair and clasp your hands together.
Raise your arms diagonally up to one side.
Chop down across your body to the opposite knee.
Rotate through your torso.
Alternate sides at an easy pace.

8327.description: A curl variation where the elbows travel back as you pull, putting the biceps under steady band tension.
instructions: Stand on the band with feet hip-width apart and hold the handles at your thighs.
Keep your chest up and core braced.
Curl by dragging your hands up your body while the elbows move behind you.
Squeeze at the top for a moment.
Lower under control until your arms are straight.

9607.description: A max-effort pull against a fixed bar at mid-thigh height. It builds force production through the hips and back.
instructions: Set a bar in a rack at mid-thigh height and grip it just outside your legs.
Stand with a flat back and slightly bent knees.
Brace your core and chest up.
Pull up on the bar as hard as you can without it moving.
Hold for 5 seconds, then release gradually.

9863.description: A side-lying leg kickback with a cable. It isolates the glutes.
instructions: Lie on your side with a cuff on your top ankle.
Position the cable behind you.
Kick your top leg back and slightly up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Return slowly.
Do your reps, then switch sides.

9927.description: A side-lying leg raise with a cable on an incline. It works the outer hip and glutes.
instructions: Lie on your side on an incline surface.
Attach the cuff to your top ankle.
Raise your top leg out to the side.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Do your reps, then switch sides.

10055.description: A narrow-stance lunge holding a dumbbell in each hand to add load for the quads and glutes.
instructions: Stand with feet close together, a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge, keeping your feet in a narrow line.
Drop your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and chest up.
Push through the front heel to stand back up.
Switch legs and repeat.

10119.description: A sideways step up against cable tension that works the glutes and thighs and challenges balance.
instructions: Stand sideways to a box with the cable handle held at your chest.
Place the near foot on the box and press through that heel.
Step up until your leg is straight and stand tall on top.
Lower slowly back to the floor with control.
Do all reps on one side, then turn around and switch.

10183.description: A front raise combined with a torso twist, working the shoulders and the obliques together.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, holding a dumbbell in both hands at thigh level.
Raise the dumbbell in front of you to chest height.
Rotate your torso to one side, turning from the ribs while your hips face forward.
Rotate back to the center and lower the dumbbell with control.
Alternate sides each rep and keep the weight light.

10439.description: Climb up using two ropes, pulling with your arms one hand over the other. It builds a strong pull and grip.
instructions: Grab one rope in each hand and hang with arms long.
Pull up with one arm while you bend your elbow close to your body.
Reach higher with the other hand and pull again.
Keep your core tight and your legs steady.
Climb to a safe height, then lower under control.

10503.description: A lat pulldown with an underhand, narrow grip. It uses the biceps more and works the lower lats.
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station and secure your thighs.
Grab the bar with a narrow underhand grip.
Lean back a little and pull the bar to your upper chest.
Keep your elbows close to your sides.
Return slowly until your arms are fully extended.

10759.description: A walking warm-up where you lift each knee high. It primes the hips and legs.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms relaxed.
Lift one knee toward your chest.
Step forward and lower it to the floor.
Repeat on the other side.
Keep your torso upright.
Walk 10-20 steps per leg.

10951.description: A raise from an L-sit position. It builds strong abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your hands on parallettes or flat beside you.
Press down to lift your hips.
Extend your legs in front of you.
Raise your legs higher and lower them back to the L position.
Keep your arms straight and shoulders down.

11015.description: Hang from a bar and move only your shoulder blades. It builds the shoulder control you need for solid pull-ups.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, arms straight.
Let your shoulders relax up toward your ears.
Pull your shoulder blades down and together to lift your body a few centimetres.
Keep your elbows locked straight the whole time.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly back to the full hang.

11271.description: A standing cable rotation that trains the obliques. Turn through your torso with your arms staying in front.
instructions: Stand side-on to a cable set at chest height and hold the handle with both hands.
Keep your arms straight and feet planted.
Rotate your torso away from the machine.
Pause, then return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

11783.description: A quick open-and-close finger drill that warms up the hands and forearms.
instructions: Hold your hands out in front of you.
Close both hands into tight fists.
Open them fast, spreading your fingers as wide as possible.
Repeat quickly for 20-30 reps.
Keep your wrists relaxed.

0007.description: A cable lat pulldown done one handle at a time, building the lats with a stretch and squeeze on each side.
instructions: Sit on the cable machine with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lean back slightly and pull the handles towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the movement, then slowly release the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在缆绳机上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
正手握住手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
稍微向后倾斜，将手柄拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢松开手柄回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0071.description: A weighted sit-up holding the bar on your chest. Strengthens the abs.
instructions: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, resting it on your chest.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在垫子上，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
正手握住杠铃，将其放在胸前。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0199.description: A straight-arm pushdown from a high pulley, moving the bar from overhead to the thighs. It isolates the lats without bending the elbows.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley cable machine.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart and a slight bend in your knees.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, keeping your arms straight and your palms facing down.
Engage your core and keep your back straight as you exhale and push the bar down towards your thighs.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return the bar to the starting position while inhaling.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将直杆连接到高滑轮电缆机上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住杠铃，保持手臂伸直，手掌朝下。
呼气时，收紧核心并保持背部挺直，并将杠铃向下推向大腿。
在底部暂停片刻，然后一边吸气，一边慢慢地将杠铃返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0263.description: A crunch that twists across the body, bringing the elbow toward the opposite knee. It emphasises the obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and twist your torso to one side.
Bring your elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower back down and repeat on the other side.
Keep your lower back on the floor.
Do not pull on your neck.

0327.description: A chest-supported dumbbell row on an incline bench. Supporting the chest takes the lower back out of the move.
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Grab a dumbbell in each hand and sit on the bench with your chest against the incline.
Extend your arms fully, allowing the dumbbells to hang straight down from your shoulders.
Pull the dumbbells up towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
双手各握一个哑铃，坐在长凳上，胸部靠在斜坡上。
充分伸展双臂，让哑铃从肩膀上垂直垂下。
将哑铃拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0391.description: Seated with an upright back, you curl dumbbells toward your shoulders. Sitting limits cheating so the biceps work harder.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your back straight and your elbows close to your torso.
Exhale and curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地面上，每只手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
保持背部挺直，肘部靠近躯干。
呼气并将哑铃向上弯向肩膀，收缩二头肌。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0455.description: You let a barbell roll to your fingertips and curl it back up. It builds finger and forearm strength for a better grip.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Rest your forearms on your thighs, allowing your wrists to hang off the edge.
Slowly curl your fingers towards your palms, squeezing the barbell tightly.
Hold the contraction for a moment, then slowly release your fingers back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地面上，反手握住杠铃，手掌朝上。
将前臂放在大腿上，让手腕悬在边缘。
慢慢地将手指向手掌弯曲，紧紧挤压杠铃。
保持收缩一会儿，然后慢慢松开手指回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0519.description: Lying on the floor, you press kettlebells up one at a time. It works the chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Start by lying on your back on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a kettlebell in each hand, with your palms facing towards your feet and your arms extended straight up towards the ceiling.
Lower one kettlebell down towards your shoulder while keeping the other kettlebell extended straight up.
Press the lowered kettlebell back up to the starting position while simultaneously lowering the other kettlebell down towards your shoulder.
Continue alternating the press motion with each kettlebell for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先仰卧在地板上，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地面上。
每只手握住一个壶铃，手掌朝向脚部，手臂伸直向天花板。
将一个壶铃向肩膀方向降低，同时保持另一个壶铃向上伸直。
将降低的壶铃按回到起始位置，同时将另一个壶铃向肩膀方向降低。
继续用每个壶铃交替进行推举动作，达到所需的重复次数。

0583.description: Kneeling on a machine, you rotate your torso against resistance. Trains the obliques and core.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your knees resting on the pads and your upper body facing forward.
Grasp the handles or the sides of the machine for stability.
Keeping your core engaged, twist your torso to one side as far as comfortably possible.
Pause for a moment, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat the twist to the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度，将自己放在机器上，膝盖放在垫子上，上半身朝前。
抓住机器的手柄或侧面以保持稳定性。
保持核心参与，将躯干尽可能舒适地向一侧扭转。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
向另一侧重复扭转。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

0647.description: A jumping variation of the wall sit. You drop into a wall squat and then explode upward, building leg power.
instructions: Stand with your back close to a wall, feet shoulder width apart.
Lower into a wall sit with your thighs parallel to the floor.
Drive through your feet and jump up explosively.
Land softly with bent knees.
Drop straight back into the sit and repeat.
Keep your chest tall and land quietly.

0711.description: A wide lunge to the side that stretches the inner thigh. It improves hip mobility.
instructions: Stand with your feet wide apart.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight.
Keep your chest up.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

0775.description: An upright row with the smith bar, pulling the bar up toward the chin with the elbows leading. It trains the side delts and traps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, facing the smith machine.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the barbell up towards your chin, leading with your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，面向史密斯机。
正手握住杠铃，双手间距略宽于肩宽。
保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将杠铃拉向下巴，用肘部引导。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0839.description: A lying trunk twist holding a weight. It works the obliques and the core.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a weight above your chest.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
Lower your knees to one side.
Return to centre and lower to the other side.
Move slowly and keep control.

0903.description: A triceps kickback with a band. It isolates the back of the upper arm.
instructions: Stand on the band, hinge forward and hold the ends.
Keep your upper arms close to your sides.
Straighten your elbows, pushing your hands back.
Squeeze your triceps at the top.
Bend slowly to return.

0967.description: The barbell deadlift seen from the front. A strong lift for the glutes, hamstrings and back.
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart, bar over mid-foot.
Hinge at the hips and grip the bar just outside your legs.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Push the floor away and stand up, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Lock out your hips at the top without leaning back.
Lower the bar by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
